n6ebfd40c6f.headline: Pedro Sánchez promises to eliminate the Social Security deficit in five years
n6ebfd40c6f.summary: Spain's Prime Minister promised to eliminate the Social Security deficit within five years and repeal a pension indexation law to align pensions with real CPI.
n6ebfd40c6f.why: Social Security deficit and pension policies are key fiscal issues affecting Spain's public finances and social welfare system.
